# Better Health Channel

> Victoria's trusted public health information resource providing comprehensive guides on conditions, treatments, prevention, and wellbeing for residents.

Better Health Channel is an official Victorian health information service offering evidence-based content on medical conditions, mental health, disease prevention, and treatment options. The site serves as a primary health literacy resource for Victorians seeking reliable health information and guidance.

## Key Topics

- Mental health conditions
- Chronic diseases
- Treatment options
- Disease prevention
- Health alerts
- COVID-19
- Infectious diseases
- Mental wellbeing
- Health services
- Healthy living
- Medical conditions
- Public health
- Victorian health
- Allergen triggers
- Health information

## Mental Health & Wellbeing

- [Mental health and wellbeing](https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au/conditionsandtreatments/mental-health-and-wellbeing): Mental health overview: eating disorders, wellbeing, treatment support
- [Depression](https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au/conditionsandtreatments/depression): Depression types, treatment options, support and warning signs
- [Anxiety](https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au/conditionsandtreatments/anxiety): Information on anxiety disorders, panic, OCD, phobias and treatment
- [Sleep](https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au/conditionsandtreatments/sleep): Sleep disorders, insomnia, sleep apnoea, hygiene and management

## Major Chronic Conditions

- [COVID-19](https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au/covid-19-victoria): COVID-19 information for Victoria: testing, vaccination, long-COVID
- [Diabetes](https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au/conditionsandtreatments/diabetes): Diabetes guide: types, prevention, blood glucose management
- [Cancer](https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au/conditionsandtreatments/cancer): Cancer overview: types, screening, treatment, risk factors
- [Stroke](https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au/conditionsandtreatments/stroke): Stroke overview: warning signs, prevention, risk factors, rehabilitation
- [Asthma](https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au/conditionsandtreatments/asthma): Asthma management, triggers, action plans and first aid information

## Infections & Diseases

- [Infections](https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au/conditionsandtreatments/infections): Infectious diseases: bacterial, viral, childhood diseases, prevention
- [Sexually transmissible infections - STIs](https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au/conditionsandtreatments/sexually-transmissible-infections): STIs guide: HIV/AIDS, hepatitis, prevention, testing, treatment
- [Allergies](https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au/conditionsandtreatments/allergies): Guide to allergies: hay fever, asthma, hives, food allergies

## Musculoskeletal & Neurological Health

- [Arthritis](https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au/conditionsandtreatments/arthritis): Guide to arthritis types: osteoarthritis, rheumatoid, juvenile idiopathic
- [Pain and pain management](https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au/conditionsandtreatments/pain): Pain management: acute, chronic, back pain, fibromyalgia treatment
- [Dementia](https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au/conditionsandtreatments/dementia): Dementia types: Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, signs, carer support

## Developmental & Behavioural Health

- [Behavioural conditions](https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au/conditionsandtreatments/behavioural-conditions): Information on autism, ADHD, disruptive behaviour disorders
- [Birth defects](https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au/conditionsandtreatments/birth-defects): Birth defects types, risks, genetic screening and fetal development

## General Health

- [Better Health Channel](https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au): Homepage for Better Health Channel providing health info for Victorians
- [Blood and blood vessels](https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au/conditionsandtreatments/blood-and-blood-vessels): Blood health: disorders, bleeding, clotting, blood transfusion info
- [Mouth and teeth](https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au/conditionsandtreatments/mouth-and-teeth): Dental care: oral health, conditions, procedures, hygiene prevention
